searches.note: Twenty four searches of a share of twenty eight for chunk h3, none of them the author's; four left unspent. Five were restricted to a house's own domain and read through their summaries: champagne-henriot.com three times (the Enchanteleurs 2015 page and sheets, the meaning of the name, the Hemera 2013 sheet), laurent-perrier.com (the Itération 26 pages) and louis-roederer.com (the Cristal 2015 press file and the Cristal page). No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: the founding year and what it is the year of, the people and their dates, the village, the kind of producer, every dated change of hands, the grapes and shares, the villages, the first vintage, vintage or multi vintage, the lees, the dosage, the bottle, the other cuvées, the traps, the cards and the questions; then the house rules (nobody living named, no price, no score, nothing volatile told as a present state, no judging superlative, British spelling, no dash).
Every table line was read aloud as a captain would say it, for a claim no source carries; the forty five second lines were counted inside 90 to 110 words by the lint.

tested.founded: 1843 and Joseph Krug (1800 to 1866): the library and the published flagships record, refuted on 12 November; not searched again.
tested.story: The rosé: the house's page dates the decision to the 1976 harvest and the first presentation to 1983, as do Sotheby's and Fine and Rare; the record called it the fruit of a Pinot Noir harvest of 1976, which no source says, and is reworded. The Édition on the front label from the 163ème: the house's own history (Tribute to Time) and a merchant, who calls the 164ème the second. The sale of January 1999 to LVMH stands on the author's Wikipedia and Wine Spectator.
tested.style: The 172ème: 146 wines of 11 years, the youngest 2016 and the oldest 1998, reserve wines 42 per cent, Pinot Noir 44, Chardonnay 36, Meunier 20, by the house's Édition page and K and L, so the order of the three grapes holds. The 173ème: 150 wines of 13 years from 2001 to 2017, 31 per cent reserve, by the house. About seven years in the cellars: the house's 163ème page.
tested.cuvee: multi vintage, the 1978 name, small old casks: the published record.
tested.table: The six spoken lines read aloud: every figure is the house's or the published record's.
tested.cards: Three cards and three questions read; the third question's options are four years a candidate could confuse, one right. The oldest of 1998 is the house's own figure for the 172ème, which the lint notes as a claim of rank: it stands, a dated fact of one blend.

changes.was: from a Pinot Noir harvest of 1976, by its own account, came a rosé first shown in 1983,
changes.now: at the 1976 harvest, by its own account, it decided to make a rosé, first presented in 1983;
changes.why: The house dates the decision to the 1976 harvest; no source makes the rosé the wine of a Pinot Noir harvest.
